certificate_wording: Mastemy Certificate of Completion — Finite Element Analysis (FEA) Intro

learning_outcomes.text: Explain the idea of discretising a domain into elements and nodes
Describe element types, shape functions and degrees of freedom
Set up a static structural problem with loads and boundary conditions
Judge mesh quality and perform a convergence study
Interpret stress and displacement results critically
Recognise common FEA pitfalls and validate against hand calculations

integrative_case: An engineer checks a cantilever mounting plate with a hole: build a mesh, apply the load and supports, refine near the hole, run a convergence study, and validate the result against a beam-theory estimate.

case-based decisions in the integrative case
